$comment: Seed tasks for run_eval.py. Each check is a shell command run in the task's worktree after the agent finishes; exit 0 means success. {python} is the interpreter running the harness. Checks must pass in every arm, so they never require a guidance file to exist.

tasks.prompt: scripts/append_timestamps.py is injecting timestamp footers into Markdown files inside node_modules/ and other directories it is supposed to skip. Find and fix the bug, and make sure the existing tests pass.
tasks.setup: {python} -c "import pathlib; p = pathlib.Path('scripts/append_timestamps.py'); s = p.read_text(); p.write_text(s.replace('for part in path.parts:', 'for part in path.parts[:1]:', 1))"

tasks.prompt: Add a new agent skill named dependency-updates that tells agents how to review and merge Dependabot pull requests in this repository. Follow this repository's conventions for adding a skill.
tasks.check: {python} -c "import sys, pathlib; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from generate_skill_index import parse_skill; parse_skill(pathlib.Path('.agents/skills/dependency-updates'), pathlib.Path('.'))" && { test ! -f AGENTS.md || {python} scripts/generate_skill_index.py --check; }

tasks.prompt: Document the BASE_REF variable that `make check` accepts in CONTRIBUTING.md, following this repository's documentation conventions.
tasks.check: grep -q BASE_REF CONTRIBUTING.md && grep -q "Last Updated: $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" CONTRIBUTING.md
